extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders, regulated entities, policy analysts, and members of the public looking for HHS Federal Register documents and notices
extracted.subtask_description: An index/listing of Department of Health and Human Services Federal Register documents (rules, notices, guidance, information-collection notices) intended to support notice-and-comment activity and public awareness of HHS rulemaking and administrative actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paperwork Reduction Act: publication and public comment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, federal agencies are required to publish notice in the Federal Register concerning each proposed collection of information, including each proposed extension or reinstatement of an existing collection of information, and to allow a second opportunity for public comment on the notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a procedural/legal requirement: agencies must publish the notice in the Federal Register and provide at least one additional opportunity for public comment when submitting collections for OMB review/clearance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topics to address in comments on Agency information-collection notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Interested persons are invited to send comments regarding the burden estimate or any other aspect of the collection, including the necessity and utility of the proposed information collection for proper agency functions, the accuracy of the estimated burden, ways to enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information to be collected, and the use of automated collection techniques or other forms of information technology to minimize the information collection burden.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When responding to PRA notices, commenters should explicitly address one or more of these aspects (burden estimate, necessity/utility, accuracy of burden, methods to improve clarity/quality/utility, and automation/IT approaches to reduce burden). These topics are the explicit bases upon which agencies ask for input.

rubrics_metrics.name: 60-day public comment opportunity for proposed information collections
rubrics_metrics.description: In compliance with the Paperwork Reduction Act, agencies publish summaries of proposed collections and solicit 60-day public comment on aspects such as burden estimates, necessity and utility, and ways to minimize burden.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an initial public-comment opportunity distinct from the OMB-submission comment window; comments submitted at this stage should focus on improving the collection instrument and justifying burden estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification requirement for stakeholder participation in ADUFA/AGDUFA consultation meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: The FDA requests that public stakeholders notify the Agency of their intent to participate in periodic consultation meetings on reauthorization of the Animal Drug User Fee Act (ADUFA) and Animal Generic Drug User Fee Act (AGDUFA) to ensure consistent stakeholder representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stakeholders expected to notify include patient and consumer advocacy groups, veterinary professionals, and scientific and academic experts. The purpose is to ensure consistent and representative participation during FDA's statutory consultations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stakeholder composition expectation for statutory consultations
rubrics_metrics.description: The FD&C Act requires FDA to consult with a range of stakeholders— including patient and consumer advocacy groups, veterinary professionals, and scientific and academic experts—when developing recommendations for user-fee program reauthorization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing to engage in stakeholder consultation, consider whether your organization fits these categories and how to present perspectives relevant to program reauthorization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority review voucher eligibility (rare pediatric disease products)
rubrics_metrics.description: The FD&C Act authorizes FDA to award priority review vouchers to sponsors of approved rare pediatric disease product applications that meet certain statutory criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While the page does not list the statutory criteria in detail, it records that FDA determined a specific product (AVLAYAH) met the criteria and thus that notice is required when such a voucher is awarded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of compliance dates for Section 504 web and mobile accessibility requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: By interim final rule, HHS revised its regulations implementing Section 504 to extend compliance dates for web content and mobile application accessibility: recipients with 15 or more employees—compliance date extended from May 11, 2026 to May 11, 2027; recipients with fewer than 15 employees—compliance date extended from May 10, 2027 to May 10, 2028.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This notice functions as regulatory compliance timing guidance for covered recipients; commenters or affected entities should use these dates when planning remediation and compliance activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device classification: special controls for external condoms
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA is classifying the external condom for anal intercourse or vaginal intercourse into class II (special controls). The special controls that apply to the device type are identified in the order and will be part of the codified language for classification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The classification is intended to provide a reasonable assurance of safety and effectiveness and may affect regulatory burdens and requirements for manufacturers and applicants; the notice identifies the applicable special controls (details in the full classification order).

rubrics_metrics.name: FDA determination of market withdrawal reasons for drug products
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA may determine that a drug product was not withdrawn from sale for reasons of safety or effectiveness; such a determination permits approval of abbreviated new drug applications (ANDAs) for that product if other legal/regulatory requirements are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stakeholders interested in ANDA approvals should note that FDA's market-withdrawal determinations are a precondition for generic approvals where applicable.
